title: Handling of header compression for control plane CIoT optimizations

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that can support header compression for control plane CIoT 5GS optimization.

entities.name: Session Management Function
entities.description: Network function that negotiates header compression configuration with the UE.

entities.name: Access and Mobility Management Function
entities.description: Network function that indicates header compression support during registration procedures.

entities.name: IP Header Compression
entities.description: Compression of IP headers using ROHC protocol for PDU sessions of IPv4, IPv6, or IPv4v6 type.

entities.name: Ethernet Header Compression
entities.description: Compression of Ethernet headers using EHC protocol for PDU sessions of Ethernet type.

entities.name: IP Header Compression Configuration IE
entities.description: Information element used to negotiate IP header compression configuration between UE and SMF.

entities.name: Ethernet Header Compression Configuration IE
entities.description: Information element used to negotiate Ethernet header compression configuration between UE and SMF.

entities.name: Registration Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where UE and AMF indicate header compression support.

entities.name: PDU Session Establishment Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where header compression configuration is negotiated.

entities.name: PDU Session Modification Procedure
entities.description: Procedure where header compression configuration is re-negotiated.

relations.description: IP header compression procedure uses the IP header compression configuration IE.
Ethernet header compression procedure uses the Ethernet header compression configuration IE.
Registration procedure requires UE to indicate header compression support.
Registration procedure requires AMF to indicate header compression support.
PDU session establishment procedure includes IP header compression negotiation.
PDU session establishment procedure includes Ethernet header compression negotiation.
PDU session modification procedure includes IP header compression re-negotiation.
PDU session modification procedure includes Ethernet header compression re-negotiation.
